<div class="card-body">
'''Sabotage''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">妨害工作</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：自分の支配フェイズに、自分の潜伏中のスパイと同じ位置カードにある武器、アイテム、ビークルを1つ目標として定める。運命数を引く。運命数＞目標の配備コストなら、目標はロストする（スパイが盗賊でもあるなら、ロストさせるかわりに盗むことができる。2：「情報提供者」をキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Sabotage-SWCA-67673.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">装備に劣る反乱軍は、帝国軍の物量に対し、秘密工作で反撃するしかなかった。コンピュータの暗号を解読したり、システムを改竄するのは最も効果的な手法であった。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Sabotage.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: During your control phase, target one weapon, device, or vehicle at the same location card as your undercover spy. Draw destiny. If destiny is greater than the target's deploy cost, the target is lost (if the spy is also a thief, you may steal it instead of making it lost).

2: Cancel Informant.

'''Lore:'''
Poorly equipped Rebels had no choice but to strike back at the Empire's numbers with secret operations. Decoding computer ciphers and tampering with systems was the most effective method.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Informant is 「情報提供者」.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Sabotage]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
